description: This Java class 'TechDataServices' provides various services related to manufacturing technical data, including retrieval and validation of routing tasks, calendar management, capacity calculations, and exception handling within the manufacturing process.

classes.name: TechDataServices
classes.description: A utility class providing services for manufacturing technical data management, including routing task lookup, calendar and capacity calculations, and exception handling.

methods.name: lookupRoutingTask
methods.description: Retrieves routing tasks filtered by name or machine group, ordered by name, with specific status and type filters.

methods.name: checkRoutingTaskAssoc
methods.description: Checks for conflicting routing task associations with overlapping periods and same sequence ID.

methods.name: getTechDataCalendar
methods.description: Fetches the TechDataCalendar associated with a routing task, defaulting if none is specified.

methods.name: dayStartCapacityAvailable
methods.description: Finds the first day from a given date where capacity is available in the calendar week, considering exceptions.

methods.name: capacityRemaining
methods.description: Calculates remaining capacity in a calendar period starting from a specific date.

methods.name: startNextDay
methods.description: Determines the start of the next available day in the calendar, considering exceptions.

methods.name: addForward
methods.description: Moves forward in time within the calendar, skipping unavailable periods.

methods.name: dayEndCapacityAvailable
methods.description: Finds the last day in the week with available capacity, moving backwards from a given day.

methods.name: capacityRemainingBackward
methods.description: Calculates the remaining capacity moving backward from a specific date.

methods.name: endPreviousDay
methods.description: Finds the previous day with available capacity, considering exceptions.

methods.name: addBackward
methods.description: Moves backward in time within the calendar, skipping unavailable periods.

methods.name: getExceptionCapacityForDate
methods.description: Retrieves exception capacity for a specific date if it exists.
